_why: Everything a member's version changes. Times are SOURCE seconds in the take (the numbers below are example values from the demo take: Claude sets them per take). The last keep range is the reaction beat, with a third number for its speed (0.5 = half speed so it lands).
_pov_lines_why: 1-2 lines, sentence case, readable in under 2 s (about 8 words), each line inside x 65-1015.
_reaction_emoji_why: A 3D emoji PNG you add to assets/img/ (e.g. from Microsoft's Fluent Emoji, MIT licence). Missing file = no emoji. Use "" for none.
_face_centre_why: x, y of your face on the 1080x1920 frame: the punch-in grows from here.
_voice_gain_why: example from the demo: it measured -14.9 LUFS in the first render; x1.11 = +0.9 dB -> -14.0. Re-measure yours with ../_shared/measure.py.
